policies: Monsoon Fire is a private home studio with no open studio hours; confirmed access details are sent with the firing handoff.
Standard dropoff and pickup can be self-serve and do not require a studio conversation.
Work should be safe to travel and clean where it meets the kiln shelf.
Artists should disclose unusual or unknown clay, glaze, repairs, or inclusions.
Anything over 10 inches tall starts at two half shelves, even when its footprint is small.
Bisque plates and bowls may stack when staff can do it safely; glazed surfaces do not stack.
Advancer shelves offer some protection from small glaze runs, but bottoms must remain clean and staff decides placement.
The studio loads and unloads the kiln and decides final fit, placement, and compatibility.
The planner gives an estimate, not a bill; the final charge is confirmed after firing from the space actually used.
A studio-caused problem has no firing charge; clay, glaze, or construction problems remain chargeable.
Pickup begins only after the studio sends the ready email.
The standard storage grace period ends 19 days and 6 hours after the ready notice; current extensions and daily charges are in the Studio Policies.
Missing a pickup deadline does not automatically transfer ownership; unclaimed work remains subject to notice and applicable law.
Responsibility is cause-based: studio fault means no charge or an appropriate refund, while other remedies are reviewed case by case.
accessModel: Private home studio in the West Valley. Instructed self-service rack dropoff and pickup are available 24/7; studio visits and lessons are arranged separately.
